findings.title: The F1 checkpoint lesson (F1.8) can never reach Completed: its fourth check reads retrieval over the lesson's concepts, and a checkpoint lesson has none
findings.evidence: eval (slot 11): after recordCheckpoint('F1'), markPage('F1.8',0) and rateCard(...,3) on argument and induction cards → evidence('F1.8').checks [true,true,null,false], peekProgress('mind','F1.8') {status:'started', check:[true,true,false,false]}, completed('F1.8') false, KOS_MIND.LESSONS['F1.8'].concepts []
findings.rootCause: evidence() derives 'retrieval' from l.concepts, which the checkpoint lesson registration leaves empty (js/data/content/mind-f1.js checkpoint lesson)
findings.fix: In evidence(), for a checkpoint lesson read the concepts from M().CHECKPOINTS[l.unit].concepts (or its cards) — or treat the checkpoint itself (cards step) as its retrieval; add a smoke110 case that a fully done checkpoint lesson reaches status done.

findings.title: Mind desk on iPhone and iPad portrait: the Daily 15 and Continue cards are crushed to 40px — the Start button, the plan and the lesson title are cut off
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/mind/s-desk-iphone-daily.png; eval (seeded, Exam Season stubbed off): ipad cardH 40 scrollH 189, Start bottom 873 vs card bottom 744; iphone cardH 40 scrollH 189, Start bottom 747 vs card bottom 618; mac (Exam Season on) card 191.6px, scrollHeight 254, overflow hidden, button top 340
findings.rootCause: Mind's side column overrides the shared side layout with a flex column that, combined with flex:1 1 0 and min-block-size:0/overflow:hidden, collapses its children
findings.fix: Give .k-mind-deskside the same treatment as Japanese/Creatives under 1080px (grid, or flex-basis auto), and on the Mac let the Daily card's content set a minimum (min-block-size: min-content) or drop the strip/blurb before the button rather than clipping the button; add the Mind desk to smoke/visual audit at 820 and 402.

findings.title: Mind ladder: most F1 concepts can never climb past Recall/Apply — 5 of 16 concepts have no route to any rung above Recall, only 3 can reach Evaluate
findings.evidence: eval over KOS_MIND (slot 11): 'premise E[] A[] V[]', 'deduction E[] A[] V[]', 'straw-man E[] A[] V[]', 'false-dilemma E[] A[] V[]', 'bandwagon E[] A[] V[]', 'soundness E[] A[F1.3#2] V[]', 'standard-form E[F1.2] A[] V[]', 'steelman E[] A[F1.7#1] V[F1.7,cp]'; rules in js/core/mind.js:278-318 (ladder); hero bars js/modules/mind.js:66-72; furthest js/core/mind.js:497-503
findings.rootCause: Ladder rules require per-concept evidence sources that the F1 content file only provides for the lesson 'main' concepts; nothing checks reachability.
findings.fix: Either author a route for every rung of every concept (apply items for each fallacy/premise/deduction; explain-back key points or checkpoint rubric rows for the rest), or let a concept declare which rungs it has (`rungs: ['Recall','Apply']`) and draw/count only those, computing the hero bars and 'furthest' over reachable rungs. smoke110 should assert every concept has a source for every rung it shows.

findings.title: Evaluate is lost whenever a position is revised: the revise sheet starts with an empty objection/reply and the ladder reads only the latest version
findings.evidence: eval (slot 11): takePosition('F1.7',{answer:1,objection:'o',reply:'y'}) → ladder('steelman').rungs[3] true, ladder('charity').rungs[3] true; then takePosition('F1.7',{answer:1,conf:60,reason:'r2'}) (what the revise sheet sends when the objection is not retyped) → ladder('steelman').rungs[3] false
findings.rootCause: ladder uses only the latest version; position() sheet does not carry the objection forward
findings.fix: Evaluate should hold if ANY version (or any non-retired position) has an objection answered; and pre-fill the revise sheet's objection/reply from the previous version (open the details when present).

findings.title: Checkpoint pays 50 XP / 12 gold / +4 HP and marks itself passed with nothing right; a retake then erases the Explain/Evaluate rungs it gave
findings.evidence: eval (slot 11): recordCheckpoint('F1',{cards:0,apply:{},synth:{bullets:['x'],ticks:{0:true,2:true}}}) → {paid:true}, governor 0/0 → 50/12; ledger [F1.8,{kind:'checkpoint',first:true},{xp:50,gold:12}]; ladder('argument').rungs[1] true, ladder('induction').rungs[3] true; retake recordCheckpoint('F1',{synth:{bullets:['y'],ticks:{}}}) → both false
findings.rootCause: recordCheckpoint has no pass condition and replaces the record on every attempt
findings.fix: Define a pass rule (e.g. ≥ 2 of 3 scenarios right and ≥ half the rubric) and pay only on the first PASS, saying what is missing otherwise; keep the best attempt (merge apply/ticks by OR, or store attempts and read the best) so a retake never lowers a rung.

findings.title: Apply and Explain rungs are earned without showing understanding: Apply after the check has revealed the answer, Explain from one one-character bullet
findings.evidence: eval (slot 11): answerCheck('F1.3',3,0) → ok:false, ladder('validity').apply 0; answerCheck('F1.3',3,1) → ok:true, apply 1, rungs [F,F,T,F]; saveExplain('F1.3',['x'],{0:1,1:1,2:1}) → {reached:true,ticked:3,of:4} with evidence('F1.3').read 0 of 6
findings.rootCause: answerCheck records ok on any later right answer; saveExplain trusts ticks with no text threshold
findings.fix: Count Apply only when the scenario is right at the FIRST attempt of a visit (or on a later day, with the answer not revealed in the same session); for a retried item show 'Right, but it counts next time'. For Explain require a minimum (e.g. ≥ 3 bullets or ~20 words) before ticks count, and order the prompt after the pages.

findings.title: Ask Kurenai offline: 'Saved to ask when you're online. You will see "What is sent" again' — the queue is written and never read
findings.evidence: grep -rn askQueue js/ → only js/modules/mindrun.js:299-300 (write); message text js/modules/mindrun.js:303; js/modules/mind.js:136
findings.fix: Either implement the queue (on 'online' or the next Mind open, show a 'You asked while offline' card that reopens the What is sent step for each queued item) or say plainly 'You're offline — try again when connected' and keep the typed words in the sheet.

findings.title: Journal entries cannot be edited or linked to a concept after capture, though capture says 'Link a concept later'
findings.evidence: js/modules/mindrun.js:371 'Link a concept later'; entryCard js/modules/mind.js:316-341 (buttons); /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/mind/s-journal2-mac.png

findings.fix: Add an Edit action on each entry that reopens the capture sheet pre-filled (kind, text, source, concept chips from metConcepts) and saves through KOS.mindJournal.put (it already keeps id and bumps updatedAt for sync); show the source field only for Quote.

findings.title: Mind is barely joined to the rest of the OS: no Reports facts or milestones, Goals' card/recall types silently read 0 for Mind, and Home/Today never mention the Daily 15 or Mind cards due
findings.evidence: grep -rln 'KOS.mind' js/ → only ui, aitools, achcatalogue, achievements, governor, art, subjects, hub, governor-ui (no report.js, goals.js, today.js, dayreview.js); eval: JSON of KOS.today.build() contains no 'mind'/'Mind' field (only 'reminder' substrings); goals.js:557-572 type filter
findings.rootCause: Mind shipped as a self-contained space; the joins listed in the plan were not built
findings.fix: Add mindFacts to report.js (reviews passed, lessons finished, checkpoints, positions taken/changed, Journal counts — totals only), let cards-reviewed/recall-rate read type 'mind' review entries when the subject is Mind (or hide Mind from those pickers), and give KOS.today a Mind item (Daily 15 not done / cards due / revisit due) through KOS.mind.planDay.

findings.title: Dialogue 'Skip to summary' on the first question gives an empty '0 turns' summary, and 'Save to Journal' saves an empty Reflection (counted by the Journal badge)

findings.title: Ask Kurenai's 'What is sent' pre-ticks the explain-back under 'Extras · tick to include', summarises instead of printing the payload, and says '1 bullets'
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/mind/s-ask-sent-mac.png; eval: checkbox [true, 'Your explain-back for this lesson 1 bullets']; payload() js/modules/mindrun.js:251-261 vs whatIsSent list :265-269; tick sub-line :277
findings.rootCause: Extras default derived from existence of an explain-back; summary list built separately from payload()
findings.fix: Default extras off (or keep the default but say 'included · untick to leave out'); add a 'Show the exact text' disclosure printing payload(); pluralise ('1 bullet').

findings.title: Checkpoint Argument Mapper: every claim starts as 'conclusion', the warning says 'Two conclusions' for five, and an untouched map still earns 'First argument mapped'
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/mind/s-cp-map-ipad.png; js/core/mindui.js:202 (fixed text); js/modules/mind.js:537 (rows seeded d:0, j:null) and :545 (Next stores mp.value())
findings.rootCause: Static warning text; milestone reads presence of r.map
findings.fix: Word the warning from the count ('5 conclusions — only one claim is the conclusion'); start rows unplaced (a neutral 'claim' label) and count the milestone only when the map has exactly one top row and every other row has a joint.

findings.title: Mind's sheets (Ask Kurenai, Quick capture, Explain-back, Position) stay open over the next page after Back or any navigation
findings.evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/mind/s-F1.8-ipad.png and s-desk-dawn-mac.png (Ask sheet for F1.3 over other pages); eval: KOS.ui.confirm then history.back() → 0 dialogs; KOS.mindRun.capture({}) then history.back() → 1 dialog remains; js/core/mindui.js:344-359

findings.fix: Close Mind sheets on navigation (listen for the router's nav event / popstate in sheet(), or route through the same close-on-navigate path the shared dialogs use), keeping the capture's 'Discard this?' guard for unsaved text.

findings.title: Mind polish: Journal card and empty Foundation strip leave large dead areas; selects render larger than the chips beside them; search glyph tiny
findings.rootCause: Page-specific sizing in css/views/mind.css (e.g. .k-mind-text/.k-mind-select :258-259) rather than the shared control scale
findings.fix: Let the Journal card shrink or show the Big Question / milestones under few entries; lay Foundation's units in the same 4-up grid as the other headers; size .k-mind-select to the 13–14px control scale; drop the ⌕ glyph (the input is already labelled); give Retake/Revise intrinsic widths.
